# The Data and AI School of London (DAIS)

> The Data and AI School of London is a UK-based, NCFE-approved online training provider delivering Ofqual-regulated qualifications in Programming, Cyber Security, Data Science, Cloud and Digital Support, and Functional Skills English. Qualifications range from Entry Level to Level 5 (including Level 4 and 5 Higher Technical Qualifications) on the Regulated Qualifications Framework (RQF). All courses are delivered 100% online with tutor support, and use portfolio-based assessment rather than traditional exams.

## Key facts

- **Name:** The Data and AI School of London (DAIS)
- **Type:** NCFE-approved centre / online further and higher technical education provider
- **Location:** Office LG06, 1 Quality Court, Chancery Lane, London WC2A 1HR, United Kingdom
- **Delivery:** 100% online across the UK via a Moodle Virtual Learning Environment
- **Regulation:** Qualifications regulated by NCFE, an Ofqual-approved Awarding Organisation; sit on the Regulated Qualifications Framework (RQF)
- **Assessment:** Portfolio-based, internally assessed and externally verified by NCFE (no traditional written exams for most qualifications)
- **Levels offered:** Entry Level to Level 5, including HTQ (Higher Technical Qualification) diplomas at Levels 4 and 5
- **Phone:** +44 207 0990 956 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm)
- **Email:** info@dataaischool.com
- **ICO registration:** ZC086597
- **Response time:** Enquiries answered within two working days

## Qualifications offered

- Programming: NCFE Level 2 Certificate in Understanding Coding; NCFE Level 3 Certificate in Coding Practices (Python, Java, C#, PHP)
- Cyber Security: NCFE Level 2 Certificate in the Principles of Cyber Security; NCFE Level 3 Certificate in Cyber Security Practices; NCFE Level 3 Technical Occupational Entry (TOE) in Cyber Security Diploma; NCFE Level 4 Diploma: Cyber Security Engineer (HTQ)
- Data Science and Analytics: NCFE Level 2 Certificate in Data Analysis; NCFE Level 3 Certificate in Data; NCFE Level 3 TOE for the Data Technician Diploma; NCFE Level 4 Diploma: Data Analyst (HTQ)
- Cloud and Digital Support: NCFE Level 3 TOE in Digital Support Diploma; NCFE Level 5 Diploma: Data Engineer (HTQ); NCFE Level 5 Diploma: Cloud Systems and Secure Networking (HTQ)
- Functional Skills English: NCFE Entry Level 1, Entry Level 2 and Entry Level 3 Functional Skills in English

## Admissions

Applicants complete a short online application form. DAIS confirms places within two working days. Entry requirements vary by level: Level 2 qualifications are open to most learners aged 16 and over; Level 4 and 5 qualifications typically require prior learning at Level 3 or equivalent experience. Each applicant is assessed individually.

The admissions process is assisted by AI team members (named Ada, Alan and Grace) that assess and recommend only. In line with UK GDPR Article 22, no automated system makes a final admissions decision; a human admissions manager reviews every assessment and makes every offer.

## Services

Beyond qualifications, DAIS designs, builds and deploys AI and automation solutions for UK organisations: AI strategy and roadmaps, workflow automation, custom AI development (chatbots, RAG knowledge bases, LLM integrations, data pipelines), and corporate AI training delivered by FHEA-qualified faculty.
